subject: prior-direct-communication-of-beta-retirement
recordedAtMeaning: Time this record was prepared from the founder's current chat instruction; not a communication or delivery date
source: Founder instruction: DOCKED — REMOVE FORMAL NOTICE REQUIREMENT AND FINALISE BETA RETIREMENT
statement: I confirm that Luke, Brenton and the other invited beta tester are personally known to me and have already been informed that Docked's beta accounts will be retired for the commercial launch. No additional formal customer-notification emails are required or authorised. Do not delay retirement until 19 November. That was a suggested date, not my approved deadline.
